description: An anonymous survey and AI sentiment app that lets multiple parties submit a 0-9 rating of something and then uses blind compute to determine the average rating. Also used AI model to analyse sentiment of user. Storing essential information such as store id, party name on orbit blockchain.
how_its_made:
This Project uses
1. Nillion: To perform blind computation on secret data.
2. Arbitrum orbit chain: To store storeid, partyname on orbit chain and for data analysis.
3. AI model for sentiment analysis
2.  Other Blockchain: To store storeid, partyname on orbit chain and for data analysis.
